Experiment 12 (13C DEPTQ, MeOD) of "Wadpressine".

- Source: Zenodo record 1233301, https://zenodo.org/records/1233301, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1233301, licence CC-BY 4.0
  (see ../wadpressine_1h/README.md for the attribution details).
- Retained files: acqus, pdata/1/{1r,procs}. Unmodified from the archive. The FID is not kept.
- Used to test the processed-spectrum path for 13C and the combined 1H + 13C zip. In a DEPTQ spectrum CH2 lines
  are negative and quaternary/CH3/CH positive; the peak picker reads positive lines only.
